synonyms: Acalypha ostryifolia Riddell ex J.M.Coult. (current Kew heterotypic synonym; nomenclatural proposal may affect preferred usage)
taxonomic_note: Current POWO/WCVP accepts Acalypha persimilis and treats A. ostryifolia as a synonym, but a recent nomenclatural conservation proposal creates ongoing name uncertainty.
look_here_first: Treat this as a reproductive-structure plant, not a leaf-shape plant. Look for an annual Acalypha with alternate serrate leaves and separate staminate/pistillate spike portions, then confirm pistillate bracts and the 3-lobed capsule.

project_inclusion.target_zone_status: UNRESOLVED NOMENCLATURE/RANGE — USER APPROVED LEARNER INCLUSION
project_inclusion.range_basis: Uvalde is the only exact project target-zone county currently locked through synonym-reconciled evidence. Two more exact target-zone counties are still needed.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification and nomenclatural finality.

best_field_traits: alternate ovate serrate leaves often 3–5-nerved from base
reproductive architecture more important than leaf shape
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Re-key against Acalypha phleoides and A. radians using reproductive spikes/bracts. Older A. ostryifolia field-guide material may refer to the same current concept.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Prioritize pistillate bracts, reproductive spike architecture, and life history; foliage alone is weak.
